Description

Want to join a gym and live or work in Maidenhead? Braywick Park Gym and Pitches has some of the best gym facilities around. Going to the gym on a regular basis is a great way to keep active and live a healthy lifestyle. Whether you're just starting out or you're a gym regular, Braywick Park Gym and Pitches is one of the best gyms in Maidenhead. The gym provides a wide array of equipment to use with expert staff to guide you on the best and safest ways to use them.

Those driving are able to park free of charge at the facility. There are limited spaces available with weekends being particularly popular. The best parking availability is during the day and before 5pm.

You have to be a member to make use of the gym facilities at Braywick Park Gym and Pitches. This means the facility is unfortunately not available to book on a one-off basis. The facility offers various membership options, so please contact the venue if you are interested in becoming a member.

There are smart and spacious changing rooms available for customers, with well-maintained facilities. This means customers can come straight from work or head out straight after.

If you're looking to travel using public transport, then the nearest station is Maidenhead. This facility has excellent public transport links making it easy for all participants to reach the venue.
